mapper.sql:
, alarm_latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(sscsdm,bsm) * FROM dwd_ql_jc_jcbj_data r ORDER BY sscsdm,bsm,tbsj DESC NULLS LAST,extract_time DESC NULLS LAST,(sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC), alarm_source AS (SELECT * FROM alarm_latest WHERE coalesce(sjtbzt,'')!='D'), filtered AS (SELECT a.*,b.qlid AS bridge_id,b.qlmc AS bridge_name FROM alarm_source a JOIN point_bridge p ON p.bsm=a.dwbsm AND p.sscsdm=a.sscsdm JOIN bridge_base b ON b.qlid=p.bridge_id
)
mapper.select:
SELECT a.bsm AS id,a.bridge_id,a.bridge_name,a.sscsdm AS city_code,a.bjsj AS time,a.bjmc AS name, a.jcbjzb AS metric,a.bjjb AS level,a.bjz AS value,a.bjyz AS threshold,h.czzt::text AS handling_status,h.wcczsj AS handled_at,count(*) OVER() AS matching_total FROM filtered a LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT czzt,wcczsj FROM dwd_ql_jc_bjcz_data h WHERE h.bjbh=a.bjbh AND left(h.xzqhdm,4)=left(a.sscsdm,4) AND coalesce(h.sjtbzt,'')!='D' ORDER BY h.gxsj DESC NULLS LAST,h.bsm LIMIT 1 ) h ON true
ORDER BY a.bjsj DESC,a.bsm,a.sscsdm LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
